name: LibreJustice
description: LibreJustice helps users research French and European case law and retrieve legal texts as they read on a specific date. It searches decisions from French administrative, judicial, constitutional, asylum and data-protection bodies as well as European courts, with filters for court, outcome, date and cited provisions. Users can open the full text of a decision, search French legislation and curated treaties or foreign codes, retrieve an article's version history, and review their own saved activity.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LibreJustice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LibreJustice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://librejustice.fr/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LibreJustice MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LibreJustice provides these MCP tools: get_decision, get_legal_text, list_my_activity, search_decisions, and search_legal_texts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LibreJustice?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to LibreJustice in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.
LibreJustice requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
LibreJustice is developed by LibreJustice. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
